statement: LogTap quickly decodes laptop QR codes and displays real-time status without delays.
The automated timestamping and borrower logging eliminate errors found in manual logbooks.
Student LRN credentials and borrowing records are securely handled and protected.
The scanning interface is intuitive for both students and laboratory teachers.

Requiring student password confirmation and teacher custody receipts improves student care for laptops.
